name: flowchart-ai
description: Create link-shared flowcharts and architecture diagrams, then revise them as new copies.

interface.longDescription: Create link-shared diagrams using ChatGPT reasoning and deterministic diagram tools. Anyone with the view link can read the chart; anyone with its private edit link can edit or delete it. No account ownership; indefinite retention unless server retention is configured or the chart is deleted. Browser edit access is available through a private MCP Apps card in supported hosts.
defaultPrompt: Diagram a signup process. Explain sharing before saving it.
